description: Sysselsatta inom transport och magasinering, efter arbetsställets belägenhet, andel (%) is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rådet för främjande av kommunala analyser - Kolada. Refers to SNI code H. Number of persons employed (15-74 years) in transport and storage divided by the total number of persons employed. Employed persons refer to persons with wage income from employment during the month of November, and persons with income from active economic activity. Coverage: Rådet för främjande av kommunala analyser - Kolada. The portal shows the English title as "Employed in transport and storage, by location of establishment, share (%)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rådet för främjande av kommunala analyser - Kolada. Its keywords include Region, Kommun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2025-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
